headline: Westmont beat both table leaders on their own grounds
dek: Hawai'i Pacific had won every match since Westmont last beat them on the same ground in October. Days earlier, Westmont had won at Vanguard, the other side level on points at the top of the table, and no other conference side has beaten both this season.
